estimand: Exploratory channel-level spectra within complete 300-second recording-relative windows; no causal inference
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly; Kaiser beta 8.6; no missing-sample interpolation
integration: Piecewise linear PSD with exact band endpoints; no zero padding
channel_selection: All ECG100C and EGG100C channels separately
invalid_windows: Nonfinite and constant raw windows retained as flags; no filling
spectral_interpretation: Descriptive only; gastric-band maxima are not verified gastric rhythm
